logp.method_description: The LogP value for 1–7 was determined using the shake-flask method and inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS). The 1-octanol used in this experiment was pre-saturated with water. A DMSO solution of 1–7 (10 μL, 10 mM) was incubated with 1-octanol (495 μL) and H2O (495 μL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shaken at room temperature for 24 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and the content of 1–7 in the water phase was determined by ICP-MS (Thermo Scientific ICAP-Qc quadrupole ICP mass spectrometer).
